prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one illustration contact sheet of EXACTLY FOUR scenes in a strict 2-column by 2-row grid. Each scene must fit entirely within its own square cell, with generous blank margin. All four share the same friendly Japanese educational notebook style: dark navy hand-drawn outlines, soft watercolor washes, cream, pale blue, butter yellow, coral, mint. Japanese adults and a cute white-and-blue robot assistant. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels. Top-left scene: a handmade craft seller at a desk with parcels, shipping tags without writing, a calendar, and robot organizing deliveries. Top-right scene: a woman with recipe cards, food photos, vegetables and a small smartphone wishlist, robot helping organize a personal recipe collection. Bottom-left scene: a solo business owner with robot at a central desk organizing two small work areas represented by a film camera and shopping basket, each with tidy project folders, conveying work by department. Bottom-right scene: a woman reviewing a website redesign on a laptop, robot holding a paintbrush and old-to-new blank website page thumbnails, no words. White or transparent background, all four vignettes distinct and self-contained. Large square composition, equally sized cells, thin or no cell dividers.
